title: Genomic DNA extraction from the diatom Pseudo-nitzschia multistriata for Illumina sequencing
author: Francesco Manfellotto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.byk7puzn
materials: Quantify DNA concentration by Nanodrop or Qubit
Grow cells as described in: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgudjws6

steps.title: Detect bacteria and collect cultures
steps.instruction: Detect the presence/absence of bacteria and collect the cultures as described in the protocol at dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.btt5nnq6.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in TE buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the harvested cells in 500 µL TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 7.6; 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0).

steps.title: Add beads and phenol
steps.instruction: Add 400 mg of 0.2–0.3 mm diameter zirconia/silica beads and 500 µL phenol (pH 7.8) to the suspension.

steps.title: Mechanical lysis by vortex
steps.instruction: Vortex the sample three times at 30 Hz for 85 seconds each, placing the tube on ice for 60 seconds before each vortex cycle.

substeps.instruction: Put tube on ice for 60 s.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 11 000 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase (≈600 µL) to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction (first round)
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1 v/v, P.C.I.) and mix by inversion.

steps.title: Centrifuge extraction mix
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 11 000 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Add RNase A
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube and add 5 µL RNase‑A (10 mg mL⁻¹).

steps.title: RNase incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Second phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1 v/v, di P.C.I.) and mix by inversion.

steps.title: Centrifuge second extraction
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 11 000 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with NaAc, ethanol, glycogen
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 2 mL Eppendorf tube and add 50 µL 3 M sodium acetate (pH ≈ 5), 1 mL 96 % ethanol (pre‑chilled to –20 °C), and 2 µL glycogen (stored at –20 °C).

steps.title: Overnight DNA precipitation at -20°C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture overnight at –20 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 13 000 g for 30 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70% ethanol (first)
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 70 % ethanol, mix gently by inversion.

steps.title: Centrifuge wash (first)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70% ethanol (second)
steps.instruction: Add another 1 mL 70 % ethanol, mix gently by inversion.

steps.title: Centrifuge wash (second)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and air‑dry the pellet at room temperature for at least 20 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in TE or water
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL pre‑heated (55 °C) TE 1× (pH 8) or sterile MilliQ water to the dried pellet.

steps.title: Heat DNA solution
steps.instruction: Incubate at 55 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Assess DNA integrity on gel
steps.instruction: Run a small aliquot of the DNA on a 1 % agarose gel to check integrity.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the DNA at +4 °C for short‑term use, or at –20 °C for longer storage.
